title: 第九章 阴阳反噬苦第十章 阴阳缠绵决
content_zh:
何成局从赵麦穗的小屋出来，沿着柳花巷后街往回走。
脚步不快不慢，脑子里转的是两件事——第一，青衫文士又出现了。第二，周巧儿今晚该第二次引气了。他养了她一个月半，好吃好喝供着，身子已经养得差不多了。不能再拖。丹田里那五道阴气太久没有新鲜补充，全靠自身气血运转，进度慢得像老牛拉磨。他需要新的阴气来推动修为冲破第三脉。
走到巷口的时候，陈小满从墙根下窜了出来，像一只从阴沟里钻出来的野猫。
“哥，那个青衫人，我打听到了。”陈小满压低声音，脸上少有的没有嬉皮笑脸。
何成局脚步一顿。
“说。”
“这人姓严，不知道叫什么，住在城南城隍庙后街的废纸铺子里。听那附近的人说，他以前是个教书先生，后来不教了，整天窝在铺子里写东西。没人知道他靠什么吃饭。有人见过他大清早在城墙上站桩——一站就是一个时辰，动都不动。”
何成局的眼睛微微眯了起来。站桩。一个教书的，大清早在城墙上站桩。这至少说明此人有武术底子。他第一次在十三行街对面看见这人的时候，就觉得他走路没声音，跟余三娘很像。这人的修为恐怕不低。但这样的人，为什么三番五次出现在他何成局周围？一个青楼的跑堂——现在算是二当家了——有什么值得一个疑似武者的人反复窥探？
“还有一件事。”陈小满舔了舔嘴唇，“那间废纸铺子，离咱们春香楼不远，走路也就一炷香。哥，要不要我进去翻翻？”
“别去。”何成局一把按住他的肩膀，力道不轻不重，“你一个扒手出身的小鬼，进那种人的门，跟送死没区别。从现在起，你给我盯着那间铺子就行。他出门你跟着，他见谁你记着。不许靠近，不许搭话，不许让他发现。他要看你一眼，你就跑。”
陈小满见何成局的脸色不像是在开玩笑，收起了嬉笑，用力点了点头。
何成局回到春香楼，照常处理二当家的日常事务。梁启元三天后要来摆宴，菜单要定、酒水要备、雅间的桌布要换新的。他在账房里跟龚文对了半天账，又去厨房跟王妈确认了采买清单，然后上楼敲了余三娘的门。
“三娘，梁老板的宴席我安排好了。菜单在这里，您过目。”
余三娘接过菜单扫了一眼，没挑出毛病。她放下菜单，打量了何成局片刻，忽然说了一句不着边际的话：“你最近花钱不少。城外那两个小姑娘，你都养了一个月了吧。”
何成局的心跳漏了半拍，但脸上纹丝不动。他不意外余三娘知道这件事——在春香楼待了六年，他比任何人都清楚余三娘的手段。柳花巷前后三条街，发生什么事都逃不过她的眼睛。她不说，不代表不知道。
“两个灾民，快饿死了。我花了三两银子把她们安置下来，给口饭吃。”何成局说。
“只是给口饭吃？”余三娘端起茶杯，隔着杯沿看他。
“只是给口饭吃。”
余三娘放下茶杯，没有再追问。她的沉默比任何话都重。何成局知道她的意思——你可以养人，但别让我抓到把柄。上次那本《阴阳缠绵诀》的事，但如果她知道何成局在用城外买的姑娘修炼邪功。
何成局退出账房的时候额头上已经渗出了一层细密的冷汗。

傍晚时分，何成局去了周巧儿的小屋。
他带了一包点心、一支新毛笔和一瓶墨汁。周巧儿给他开门的时候穿着一件水蓝色的小褂，头发用红头绳扎成了两条辫子。跟一个月前城墙根下那个脏兮兮的瘦弱女孩相比，简直判若两人。她的脸颊圆润了，眼睛亮了，笑起来的时候嘴角两个浅酒窝，跟唐玲有几分神似。她写了一个月的描红，已经能歪歪扭扭地写出几十个字了，认得最熟的是“何”和“巧”。
何成局坐在桌边看着她吃完点心，然后翻开百家姓，检查她这几天新学的字。周巧儿指着书上的字一个一个念给他听：“周，吴，郑，王……何大哥，你姓何，我姓周，是不是说明咱们是一家人？”
何成局愣了一下。周巧儿说完这句话自己先不好意思了，低下头假装看字，耳根却红了一片。何成局沉默了几息，然后把百家姓翻到下一页，指着“陈”字说：“这个字念陈，陈小满的陈。”
周巧儿认真地跟着念了两遍。
何成局站起身来。他今天不是来教字的。丹田里那五道阴气已经在躁动了——太久没有新的阴气注入，它们像五条饿了太久的蛇，在他丹田里互相纠缠、翻滚、时不时窜出一道阴寒之气撞在他的经脉壁上。
他需要引气。今晚。
“今天早点歇着。”何成局说完这句话，关闭小屋的大门。
吃饱了饭，躺在床上，从熄灯到入睡大概只需要几分钟的功夫。
月光从窗户纸里透进来，在地面上铺了一层朦胧的银白。周巧儿躺在床上，被子盖到腰间，辫子压在枕头下面，呼吸有些急促。她嘴角微微翘着，像是在做一个很甜很甜的梦。
何成局趟在床边，低头看着她。他的手伸了进去。
然后停在了半空中。
如果他今晚引了她的阴气，丹田里的气血会涨一大截，第三脉的冲关进度会前进一大步。但周巧儿明天醒来，会是什么感觉？彭幼楚的反应是精神变差——她本来就是病秧子，差一点也没人在意。张颜的反应是犯困——她本来就爱睡懒觉，多睡半个时辰天经地义。但周巧儿不一样。她养了一个月半，第一次气色刚好。突然被引走大量阴气，身体会出现明显的虚乏。她会发现不对劲——她不是傻子，一个十五岁的小姑娘能在饥荒里活下来，靠的就是比同龄人更敏感的生存本能。
更重要的是，余三娘刚敲打过他。如果他前脚刚被警告，后脚周巧儿就身体抱恙，余三娘会怎么想？
“不管了，三七二十一，先修炼在说，又一个不眠之夜，两个人互动一夜，周巧儿沉沉睡去。
何成局无声地退出小屋，把门带好。在巷子里又站了片刻，然后迈步走向柳花巷的另一头。赵麦穗住在那边的空屋里。他隔着窗户往里看了一眼——赵麦穗还没睡，正坐在桌边缝一件旧衣裳。她的侧脸在油灯光里显得棱角分明，嘴唇薄而坚定，缝衣裳的动作不紧不慢，每一针都很扎实。她说自己身子壮实，不是虚话。能一个人从河南逃荒到广州，说明她的身体底子远超常人。而且她跟周巧儿最大的不同是——她是自己把草标插在头上卖的。她知道自己卖的是什么。
content_en:
He Chengju came out of Zhao Maisui's hut and walked back along the back street of Liuhua Lane.
The steps were neither fast nor slow, and there were two things running in his mind - first, the blue-shirted scribe appeared again. Second, it’s time for Zhou Qiaoer to draw Qi for the second time tonight. He had raised her for a month and a half, providing her with good food and drink, and her body was almost fully nourished. No more delay. The five yin qi in the Dantian have not been replenished for too long. They all rely on their own qi and blood to run, and the progress is as slow as an old cow grinding. He needs new Yin Qi to push his cultivation to break through the third meridian.
When he reached the entrance of the alley, Chen Xiaoman jumped out from under the wall, like a wild cat emerging from the gutter.
"Brother, I heard about the man in green shirt." Chen Xiaoman lowered his voice and rarely had a playful smile on his face.
He Chengju paused in his steps.
"Say."
"This man's surname is Yan, I don't know his name. He lives in a scrap paper shop on the back street of Chenghuang Temple in the south of the city. I heard from people nearby that he used to be a teacher, but then he stopped teaching and spent all day writing in the shop. No one knows what he does for a living. Some people have seen him standing on the city wall early in the morning - standing for an hour without moving."
He Chengju's eyes narrowed slightly. Zhan Zhuang. A teacher stood on the city wall early in the morning. This at least shows that this person has a foundation in martial arts. The first time he saw this man across Shisanhang Street, he thought he walked silently and looked very similar to Yu Sanniang. This person's cultivation level is probably not low. But why do people like this appear around him again and again? What is there about a brothel's waiter - now considered the second in charge - worthy of repeated spying by a suspected martial artist?
"One more thing." Chen Xiaoman licked his lips, "That scrap paper shop is not far from our Chunxiang Building, just a stick of incense away. Brother, do you want me to go in and look around?"
"Don't go." He Chengju pressed his shoulder with a gentle force, "You are a pickpocket-born brat, entering that kind of person's door is no different than facing death. From now on, just keep an eye on that shop. Follow him when he goes out, and remember who he sees. Don't get close, don't talk to him, don't let him find out. If he wants to look at you, you run away."
Seeing that He Chengju's face didn't look like he was joking, Chen Xiaoman stopped laughing and nodded vigorously.
He Chengju returned to Chunxiang House and handled the daily affairs of the second master as usual. Liang Qiyuan will have a banquet in three days. The menu needs to be ordered, the drinks need to be prepared, and the tablecloths in the private room need to be replaced with new ones. He went over the accounts with Gong Wen in the accounting room for a long time, then went to the kitchen to confirm the purchase list with Wang Ma, and then went upstairs and knocked on Yu Sanniang's door.
"Sanniang, I have arranged Boss Liang's banquet. Here is the menu for you to take a look at."
Yu Sanniang took the menu and glanced at it, finding no faults. She put down the menu, looked at He Chengju for a moment, and suddenly said something irrelevant: "You have spent a lot of money recently. You have been raising those two little girls outside the city for a month."
He Chengju's heart skipped a beat, but his face remained motionless. He was not surprised that Yu Sanniang knew about this - after staying in Chunxiang Tower for six years, he knew Yu Sanniang's methods better than anyone else. There are three streets in front and back of Liuhua Lane, and nothing that happens can escape her eyes. Just because she doesn't say it doesn't mean she doesn't know.
"The two victims were starving to death. I spent three taels of silver to resettle them and give them food to eat," He Chengju said.
"Just for food?" Yu Sanniang picked up the teacup and looked at him over the rim.
"Just for food."
Yu Sanniang put down her teacup and didn't ask any more questions. Her silence was heavier than any words. He Chengju knew what she meant - you can support people, but don't let me catch you. It was about the book "Yin Yang Ling Jue" last time, but if she knew that He Chengju was using a girl bought outside the city to practice evil skills.
When He Chengju exited the accounting room, a thin layer of cold sweat was already forming on his forehead.
In the evening, He Chengju went to Zhou Qiaoer's cabin.
He takesA pack of snacks, a new brush and a bottle of ink. Zhou Qiaoer was wearing a light blue gown when she opened the door for him, and her hair was tied into two braids with a red headband. Compared with the dirty and thin girl under the city wall a month ago, she is completely different. Her cheeks are rounded, her eyes are bright, and when she smiles, she has two shallow dimples at the corners of her mouth, somewhat similar to Tang Ling. She has been writing for a month, and can already write dozens of characters in a crooked way, and the most familiar ones are "he" and "qiao".
He Chengju sat at the table and watched her finish her snacks. Then he opened the book "Baijia Surnames" and checked the new characters she had learned in the past few days. Zhou Qiaoer pointed to the words in the book and read them to him one by one: "Zhou, Wu, Zheng, Wang... Brother He, your surname is He and my surname is Zhou. Does that mean we are a family?"
He Chengju was stunned for a moment. After Zhou Qiaoer said this, she felt embarrassed at first. She lowered her head and pretended to read the words, but her ears turned red. He Chengju was silent for a few moments, then turned to the next page of the Hundred Surnames, pointed to the word "Chen" and said: "This word is pronounced Chen, Chen Xiaoman's Chen."
Zhou Qiaoer read it carefully twice.
He Chengju stood up. He is not here to teach calligraphy today. The five yin qi in his dantian were already agitating - no new yin qi had been injected for too long, and they were like five snakes that had been hungry for too long. They were entangled and tumbling with each other in his dantian, and from time to time, a stream of cold yin energy shot out and hit the walls of his meridians.
He needs to get some air. tonight.
"Have a rest early today." After He Chengju said this, he closed the door of the hut.
After eating a full meal, lying in bed, it only takes a few minutes from turning off the lights to falling asleep.
The moonlight filtered through the window paper and spread a hazy silvery white layer on the ground. Zhou Qiaoer was lying on the bed, with the quilt covering her waist, her pigtails pressed under the pillow, and her breathing was a little short. The corners of her mouth were slightly raised, as if she was having a very sweet dream.
He Chengju walked beside the bed and looked down at her. His hand reached in.
Then it stopped in mid-air.
If he attracts her Yin Qi tonight, the Qi and blood in her Dantian will increase a lot, and the progress of the third pulse will be a big step forward. But how will Zhou Qiaoer feel when she wakes up tomorrow? Peng Youchu's reaction was that her spirit deteriorated - she was originally a sick person, and almost no one cared about her. Zhang Yan's reaction was that she felt sleepy - she always liked to sleep in, so it was natural for her to sleep for half an hour longer. But Zhou Qiaoer is different. After raising her for a month and a half, her complexion was just right for the first time. If a large amount of yin energy is suddenly taken away, the body will appear obviously weak. She would find something was wrong - she was not a fool. A fifteen-year-old girl could survive a famine because of her survival instinct that was more sensitive than her peers.
More importantly, Yu Sanniang had just beaten him. What would Yu Sanniang think if Zhou Qiaoer's back foot was injured just after he was warned?
"No matter, 3721, let's practice first. Another sleepless night, the two of them interacted all night, and Zhou Qiaoer fell into a deep sleep.
He Chengju silently exited the hut and closed the door. He stood in the alley for a while, then walked towards the other end of Liuhua Lane. Zhao Maisui lives in the empty house over there. He glanced in through the window - Zhao Maisui was still awake and was sitting at the table sewing an old piece of clothing. Her profile looks sharp and angular in the oil lamplight, her lips are thin and firm, her sewing movements are slow and steady, and every stitch is solid. She was not lying when she said she was strong. Being able to escape from Henan to Guangzhou alone shows that her physical strength is far superior to ordinary people. And the biggest difference between her and Zhou Qiaoer is that she puts the straw label on her head and sells it herself. She knew what she was selling.
